During the Vietnam War, the Viet Cong turned the jungle into a deadly obstacle course! From hidden punji stake pits and brutal foot traps to tripwires and swinging spiked weapons, even a single wrong step could be devastating. These simple but terrifying traps were designed to wound soldiers, spread fear, and destroy morale.
